NPU04199 is a laboratory code used in the Danish healthcare system to identify the measurement of [[thyreoideastimulerende-hormon-tsh|thyreoideastimulerende hormon (TSH)]] [^src1]. It is formally recognized within the national clinical quality guidelines for atrial fibrillation, managed by the Regionernes Kliniske Kvalitetsudviklingsprogram (RKKP) [^src1]. 

In the technical documentation defining the calculation rules for clinical quality indicators, NPU04199 is listed as one of the valid laboratory codes that satisfy the requirements for a performed TSH measurement under "Indicator 3" [^src1]. This indicator is part of a broader national quality initiative designed to monitor and enforce evidence-based standards in the diagnosis and treatment of atrial fibrillation, sitting alongside other metrics like echocardiography and waiting times for anticoagulation therapy [^src1]. When calculating the numerator for the TSH measurement indicator, NPU04199 is accepted alongside several other specific laboratory and assay codes, such as NPU27547, NPU04200, NPU03624, and DNK35895 [^src1].
